description: This file defines the ProfilerExtension class for the Twig templating engine, responsible for managing profiling data during template rendering including entering and leaving profiling nodes.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\ProfilerExtension
classes.description: Extension class that integrates profiling capabilities into Twig templates, tracking execution profiles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProfilerExtension with a Profile object.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Marks the entry point for a profiling profile, adding it to active profiles.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Marks the exit point for a profiling profile, managing the active profiles stack.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array of node visitors used for profiling during template parsing.
